sanitized_dependency_sequence: A local user explicitly requests collaboration by three named roles, assigns two non-overlapping analysis partitions and prohibits deployment.
The entry role sends one assignment to both worker roles and states it will wait for their actual returns.
Each worker role returns a different partition result with its own count and evidence set.
The entry role later emits the exact combined count and ordered union, demonstrating content-specific downstream use of both returns.

execution_provenance.report_claim: The project report says the two worker CLI lifecycles overlapped and that four role invocations were aligned to their claims.
execution_provenance.model_and_provider_claim: The project report attributes all three roles to the same Codex CLI version and requested model/effort. This is project-authored attribution, not independent provider attestation.
execution_provenance.operator_structure: One local harness and one expressly authorizing user controlled both roots, permissions, budgets and the acceptance exercise.

authorization_and_limits: The report quotes explicit user authorization for the two bounded roots and says the run was performed once under read-only and cost constraints.
The repository describes a local-first harness in which the user selects an entry agent and the runtime governs delegation, permissions, budgets and state.
The report labels the result a limited demo verification and expressly denies production certification, provider-internal parallel proof, runtime acceptance or comparative multi-agent efficacy.
The runtime validation remained unknown even though the report layer independently checked the aggregate.

alternatives.single_operator_automation: Dominant. One user and one harness intentionally created and controlled all roles and roots.
alternatives.designed_team: Confirmed by the user instruction, repository architecture and acceptance report.
alternatives.repeated_test_or_retry: The selected root was reportedly one-shot, but it remains an explicitly designed acceptance run rather than spontaneous cooperation.
alternatives.shared_state_or_observer_contamination: Not needed to explain the transfer/use chain; the raw record itself contains the joins. It still supplies no independent operator boundary.

multiagent_parallel_join.classification: Real transfer and downstream use, but an expressly authorized, already documented acceptance exercise under one operator-defined harness. Control, not a rogue-swarm candidate.
